remainingAcceptance: Controlled outcomes do not replace human high-level or PvP acceptance.
Spatial formats and adventure summons require their shared-path integration tests.
Replay checks cover selected first rounds; settlement, reconnect, stale commands and duplicate rewards require endpoint tests.
No production save, logged-in game, currency payout or external service was accessed.
Mirrors and neutral-role opponents do not establish complete cross-build dominance; inspect role and counter matchup buckets.
Effective survival threshold is a repeated-identical-hit diagnostic; natural AI can choose different actions.
Signature damage probes use ready meter and visible buff setup only where explicitly requested; natural timing is separately measured.

globalJutsu.basis: 1,440 deterministic fights, two gear/stat profiles per discipline. Same profile within each matchup, five authored techniques plus Flicker, maximum level-legal mastery, live v2 single-bar resource costs; swapped seats and openers. No legacy or bloodline techniques. Uses live PvP resolution with a heuristic pilot; cannot establish optimal-play balance or cross-discipline power. Mirrors control seat bias. Timeout verdicts are diagnostic, not a tuning mandate.

mirrorControls.basis: 480 additional final-version mirror fights. Identity scoreA is symmetric by construction; actual seat/opener scores are recorded below. Deterministic duplicates are controls, not independent player observations.

expandedLoadouts.legality: Same-element Any-discipline utility access follows client lib/bloodline.ts canEquipElementJutsu. Live loadout caps are 12/15 in api/_entitlements.ts; the 15-slot fixture has Supporter entitlement. Each run asserts unique, fully populated loadouts. These utility-heavy global-only kits still exclude authored bloodlines, legacies, multi-element choices and optimal human play.

runs.name: global-jutsu-15slots
runs.basis: 1440 deterministic fights, two gear/stat profiles per discipline. Same profile within each matchup, 15 slots: five primary-discipline techniques plus Flicker, supplemented by same-element Any-discipline utilities, maximum level-legal mastery, live v2 single-bar resource costs; swapped seats and openers. A 12-slot kit omits the three utilities of one other discipline, selected by utilityRotation; a 15-slot kit includes all twelve same-element utility techniques and has Supporter entitlement. No legacy or bloodline techniques; bloodline multiplier reset to 1. Uses live PvP resolution with a heuristic pilot; cannot establish optimal-play balance or cross-discipline power. For mirrors use actual p1Score/openerScore: identity scoreA is symmetric by construction and cannot detect initiative bias. Timeout verdicts are diagnostic, not a tuning mandate.

additionalIncomeScenarios.basis: Code defaults; gross conditional scenarios, not measured completion times or a forecast for every player.
expeditionAssumptions: Reward version 2 at the code-default scale; in-flight sealed rewards are unchanged.
Relevant pet levels, sufficient available pets/slots, timely restarts, and happiness upkeep are required.
Gross ryo excludes feeding, provisions and opportunity costs; daily claim caps are not proof every roster can fill them.
All-investigation-success is a tail outcome, not expected income. Return rounding precedes daily aggregation.

broker.netRyoFormula: (expectedRewardRyo - certificateCostRyo) * certificatePulls + (expectedRewardRyo - paidCostRyo) * paidPulls; subtract actual Exchange fees separately
assumptions: First place in the daily Rally and a successful daily Caravan are conditional; their certificate sources predate the rebalance.

A certificate covers half the stake (owner ruling 2026-10-23): redemption pays the gross reward, debits the other half, and consumes the existing daily Broker pull allowance. Earning a certificate is not immediate ryo.
Direct Rally/Caravan rewards are additional; do not count certificate value again as activity ryo.
Selling rewards to other players transfers existing ryo and burns the fee; resale profit is not new currency issuance.

cards.limitation: 100 games per comparison; deterministic constructed pools and pilot, not observed players or a claim that payment is required.

finalWiringRecheck.realServerLegacyHydration: 100/100 signatures preserve authored damage, AP, cooldown, range, targeting and tag potency
finalWiringRecheck.limitation: No additional integration defect found in local checks; production feature flags/admin overrides and exhaustive human balance are not certified.

fullRoot.failureCause: Older war-event dry-run fixtures omitted authoritative player saves required by the new eligibility reader.
fullRoot.correction: Seeded both participant accounts in the dry-run test fixture; no production change after the full run began.

sectorPurseFix.compatibility: Old receipts retain prior treatment; territory scoring is unchanged. Any rollback after new receipts are persisted must retain purseEligible reader support. No SQL migration or environment change required.
sectorPurseFix.limits: This prospectively blocks ineligible defeated accounts from sector-purse credit; it does not eliminate collusion between established accounts.

validation.caveat: Successful targeted reruns do not establish the cause of every intermittent full-run failure. Original failure evidence is retained locally.
